verdict.rationale: Postman's docs say that without signing in you can still send multi-protocol requests using a 'lightweight API client', which covers only basic request sending without an account. Nothing documents a local, offline workspace with collections. Community reports describe Postman requiring cloud connectivity and becoming increasingly restrictive for non-logged-in users, which limits the extent of this support. Missing for 10: documented local/offline workspace mode, saving collections and environments locally without an account, an explicit offline operation guarantee, and independent corroboration of account-free workflows.
